basic.name: Snow Blind
basic.description: Throw a snowball that hits all enemies in an area. Enemies hit take 70~~0.04~~ damage, are Slowed by 35%, and are Blinded for 1.75 seconds.

basic.name: Blizzard
basic.description: Command Snowball to create a Blizzard at the target location for 2 seconds. Enemies within the blizzard take 13~~0.04~~ damage every 0.25 seconds and are Slowed by 7%, stacking up to 35%. When the Blizzard ends, enemies within its area take an additional 75~~0.04~~ damage and are Stunned for 1.25 seconds.

basic.name: Icing
basic.description:
Slide quickly in the targeted direction. When this effect ends, enemies near Mei are knocked back, take 52~~0.04~~ damage, and are Slowed by 80%, rapidly decaying over 1.5 seconds.

Can be canceled during sliding.

heroic.name: Avalanche
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

heroic.name: Ice Wall
heroic.description:
Vector Targeting
After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

trait.name: Cryo-Freeze
trait.description: Become encased in ice for 3 seconds, gaining a rapidly decaying Shield that absorbs up to 1104~~0.04~~ damage. While active, this Shield grants Unstoppable and restores up to 35% of Mei's maximum Health.

activable.name: Backup Battery
activable.description: Activate to remove all Roots and Slows and regenerate 20% of maximum Health over 2 seconds. The cooldown of this ability is reduced by 10 seconds each time Mei picks up a Regeneration Globe.

activable.name: The Big One
activable.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

activable.name: Flash Freeze
activable.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

level1.name: Heavy Pack
level1.description: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.

level1.name: Ice Storm
level1.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42~~0.04~~ damage. Blizzard's final Stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

level1.name: Heat Transfer
level1.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16~~0.04~~ Health.

level4.name: Slushball
level4.description: Snow Blind deals 75% increased damage and Structures hit are disabled for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Cold Front
level4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Icing by 3 seconds. If Mei enters her own Blizzard while Icing is active, the cooldown of Icing is reduced by 5 seconds and she gains 80 Mana.

level4.name: Crystallize
level4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

level7.name: Induce Hibernation
level7.description:
Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%. 

When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

level7.name: Skating Away
level7.description: When Icing ends, Mei and all nearby allied Heroes gain 20% Movement Speed and 50 Physical Armor for 3 seconds.

level7.name: Backup Battery
level7.description: Activate to remove all Roots and Slows and regenerate 20% of maximum Health over 2 seconds. The cooldown of this ability is reduced by 10 seconds each time Mei picks up a Regeneration Globe.

level10.name: Avalanche
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

level10.name: Ice Wall
level10.description:
Vector Targeting
After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

level13.name: Flurry
level13.description: While in her own Blizzard, Mei gains 50% increased Attack Speed and Blizzard's cooldown refreshes 125% faster. If Mei is in her own Blizzard when it ends, gain these bonuses for 3 additional seconds.

level13.name: Cooling Servos
level13.description:
While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.

Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

level13.name: Polar Vortex
level13.description: Using an ability causes Mei to deal 24~~0.04~~ damage a second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes damaged by this effect also have their Movement Speed and Attack Speed Slowed by 20%.

level16.name: Fresh Powder
level16.description: Snow Blind gains an additional charge and its range is increased by 33%.

level16.name: Black Ice
level16.description: Icing's Slow effect no longer decays over its duration. Icing deals 300% more damage to enemies very close to Mei.

level16.name: Acclimation
level16.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

level20.name: Cascade
level20.description:
While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

level20.name: Shatter
level20.description: When Ice Wall expires, trapped enemy Heroes hit take 210~~0.04~~ damage and have their Armor reduced by 25 for 5 seconds.

level20.name: The Big One
level20.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

level20.name: Flash Freeze
level20.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.
